summary: Gaxos.ai Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an asset sale to Game Foundry AI on June 18, 2026. The company sold substantially all of its gaming assets, including mobile games and Gaxos Gaming Lab, in exchange for 2,200,000 shares of the buyer's common stock valued at approximately $1,760,000. The shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. No board recommendation or advisors were named in the filing. The mechanics involve a private issuance of shares, with no premium or cash consideration stated. The transaction closed simultaneously with execution. What to watch: valuation of the buyer's stock and any subsequent trading of Gaxos.ai shares post-sale.
